title: Giants put Greg Newsome on injured reserve

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants put Greg Newsome on injured reserve
sources.description: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said on Monday that cornerback Greg Newsome will miss multiple weeks with a high-ankle sprain and a clearer picture of just how many weeks came on Tuesday.
